examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The full composer: attach files (pick, drop or paste), a model and effort picker (star a model to add it to the favorites; the bar under the panel holds a speed toggle, Ultracode and the access mode), dictation, a voice-conversation control that becomes Submit once there is something to send, and a row under the box with a project picker, files, plugins and a desktop-app link. Enter submits, Shift+Enter adds a line.

examples.name: Streaming
examples.summary: After a submit the Submit control becomes Stop while the response is generated; the reader can keep typing but cannot send until it ends or they stop it.

examples.name: CharacterLimit
examples.summary: A 280-character limit: the counter appears once the prompt reaches 80% of it (224 characters) and shows how many are used, and over the limit the frame and counter turn danger and Submit disables. A short prompt shows no counter.
